GCA Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 23rd

Get ready for an exciting evening of traditional Garba, Raas, Gujarati music, dance, and Navratri celebration in Fremont. Bring your family and friends and enjoy a festive night filled with vibrant music, energetic dancing, and community fun.

Experience the vibrant spirit of Navratri with traditional Garba and Raas, Gujarati culture, live musical performances, and a lively festive atmosphere featuring the Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group.

Date: October 23, 2026

Time: 7:30 PM | Doors Open at 7:00 PM

Venue: Washington High School

Address: 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA 94536
